records.subject: (LCP/KI) ionic thermoelectric material
records.quote: Inspired by the natural water and ions transport structures within trees, this study develops an i-TE material, (LCP/KI) i-TE, using lignocellulose (LC) as a three-dimensional framework and polyvinyl alcohol/potassium iodide (PVA/KI) as the electrolyte.
records.conditions: Inspired by tree water and ion transport structures

records.subject: Biomimetic reciprocating ion migration
records.object: Ionic Seebeck coefficient of 35 mV K-1
records.quote: This biomimetic ion reciprocating migration strategy not only enables the (LCP/KI) i-TE to achieve a high ionic Seebeck coefficient of 35 mV K-1 under small temperature differences (<1 K), but also overcomes the core bottleneck of conventional ionic thermoelectric capacitors (i-TECs)-the necessity for intermittent operation due to ion polarization saturation.

records.subject: Biomimetic reciprocating ion migration
records.object: Two-stage operation with continuous power output throughout
records.quote: This biomimetic ion reciprocating migration strategy not only enables the (LCP/KI) i-TE to achieve a high ionic Seebeck coefficient of 35 mV K-1 under small temperature differences (<1 K), but also overcomes the core bottleneck of conventional ionic thermoelectric capacitors (i-TECs)-the necessity for intermittent operation due to ion polarization saturation.
